headline: 1,484 hospitalized as 5 more die of dengue in 24 hours
summary: The total death toll for the year has reached 176, according to the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the DGHS.
details: Five people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours, while 1,484 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country.
According to a regular bulletin from the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) issued on Thursday.
The hospitalizations were spread across various regions: 252 in Khulna, 227 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 207 in Dhaka North City Corporation, and 211 in Barishal.
Other admissions included 192 in Chattogram, 190 in Dhaka (outside city corporations), 102 in Rajshahi, 64 in Mymensingh, 35 in Rangpur, and 4 in Sylhet.
With these latest deaths, the total number of dengue fatalities in Bangladesh for the current year has risen to 176.
caption:
5 deaths and nearly 1,500 hospitalizations in just one day. Dengue continues to surge across Bangladesh.

Five people died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours, while 1,484 new patients were admitted to hospitals across the country.

According to a regular bulletin from the Health Emergency Operation Center and Control Room of the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) issued on Thursday.

The hospitalizations were spread across various regions: 252 in Khulna, 227 in Dhaka South City Corporation, 207 in Dhaka North City Corporation, and 211 in Barishal.

Other admissions included 192 in Chattogram, 190 in Dhaka (outside city corporations), 102 in Rajshahi, 64 in Mymensingh, 35 in Rangpur, and 4 in Sylhet.

With these latest deaths, the total number of dengue fatalities in Bangladesh for the current year has risen to 176.

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star

headline: Viral audio: Cantonment OC withdrawn over comments on Hasina's return
summary: Officer-in-Charge Md. Rakibul Hasan was removed after an audio clip surfaced where he allegedly claimed police would be powerless if Sheikh Hasina returned.
details: Md. Rakibul Hasan, the Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Cantonment Police Station, has been withdrawn from his post following the viral spread of a controversial audio clip.
caption:
A viral audio clip alleging police powerlessness and corruption has led to the removal of a Dhaka police chief.

Md. Rakibul Hasan, the Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Cantonment Police Station, has been withdrawn from his post following the viral spread of a controversial audio clip.
